protocol.purpose: Paired Base/final-SFT heldout structure and response-length sanity; no exam accuracy evaluation
protocol.selection: first 25 frozen validation records of each source, in frozen file order
protocol.prompt_policy: original user/history messages, native Qwen template; no added format instruction
protocol.secondary_trigger: final-SFT answer closure below 0.95 or truncation above 0.05 at 1024; repeat both models on all same prompts
protocol.human_review_scope: format, reasoning presence/length, answer completeness and repetition; no unsupported medical-correctness score
